title: IgnisX
tagline: Trustless on-chain autopilot that auto-rebalances your multi-chain crypto portfolio
description:
IgnisX is an on-chain autopilot for multi-chain crypto portfolios. It helps users maintain target asset ratios (like 50% ETH and 50% USDC) by automatically executing swaps across chains.

Users connect wallets, set their allocation targets, and authorize a limited agent that monitors prices and rebalances when targets drift. The system uses Avail’s Nexus SDK to find and route liquidity across chains and Lit Protocol’s Vincent framework to handle delegated, policy-limited signing for safe automated trades.

Everything runs fully on-chain, with no custody risk. Users stay in full control of funds while IgnisX keeps their portfolio balanced.

IgnisX solves a major pain point for multi-chain users: managing assets scattered across networks without manual bridging or constant monitoring. It blends real utility, automation, and safety — a DeFi tool users would actually use daily.
how_its_made:
IgnisX is built using Solidity, Hardhat, React, and TypeScript. It combines Avail Nexus, Lit Protocol, and Pyth to power automated, cross-chain portfolio rebalancing. 

Implementation plan:
- Deploy contracts to Ethereum 
- Use Avail Nexus SDK to simulate or fetch cross-chain routes.
- Create delegated signing flow with Lit Vincent PKP.
- Use Hardhat fork for real-time DEX quotes.
- Build a simple UI to show allocations, rebalances, and audit logs.

Partner tech impact:
- Avail Nexus: Simplifies cross-chain liquidity routing.
- Lit Protocol: Enables safe automation without private keys.
